commands.command: dotnet restore dcArca.Core.Tests/dcArca.Core.Tests.csproj && dotnet restore dcArca.McpServer.Tests/dcArca.McpServer.Tests.csproj && dotnet restore dcArca.Cli.Tests/dcArca.Cli.Tests.csproj
commands.purpose: Restore the test projects affected by fiscal identity and configuration changes

commands.command: dotnet build dcArca.Core.Tests/dcArca.Core.Tests.csproj --configuration Release --no-restore && dotnet build dcArca.McpServer.Tests/dcArca.McpServer.Tests.csproj --configuration Release --no-restore && dotnet build dcArca.Cli.Tests/dcArca.Cli.Tests.csproj --configuration Release --no-restore
commands.purpose: Build Core, MCP and CLI test surfaces

commands.command: dotnet test dcArca.Core.Tests/dcArca.Core.Tests.csproj --configuration Release --no-build && dotnet test dcArca.McpServer.Tests/dcArca.McpServer.Tests.csproj --configuration Release --no-build && dotnet test dcArca.Cli.Tests/dcArca.Cli.Tests.csproj --configuration Release --no-build
commands.purpose: Run deterministic Core, MCP and CLI regression suites

commands.command: git diff --check origin/main...HEAD && test -z "$(git ls-files | grep -Ei '\.(pfx|p12|p8|key|pem)$' || true)"
commands.purpose: Reject whitespace errors and tracked certificate or private-key files
